text:
Conditional integration, K_I > 0
dI/dt = 0 when u_raw ≥ u_max and e > 0
dI/dt = 0 when u_raw ≤ u_min and e < 0
dI/dt = K_I e otherwise
provenance: Factual relations and notation. Source: John D. Hedengren, APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, PID lesson; https://apmonitor.com/pdc/index.php/Main/ProportionalIntegralDerivative. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text:
e_k = r_k − y_k
I_k = I_(k−1) + K_I Δt e_k
D_k = −K_D(y_k − y_(k−1))/Δt
u_k = b + K_P e_k + I_k + D_k
provenance: Factual relations and notation. Source: John D. Hedengren, APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, PID lesson; https://apmonitor.com/pdc/index.php/Main/ProportionalIntegralDerivative. Consulted 2026-10-13.

u_applied = min(u_max, max(u_min, u_requested))
u_min ≤ u_applied ≤ u_max
